Definition: adverb from G804; securely (literally or figuratively):--assuredly, safely.
BiblicalUsage: Peter told the crowd at Pentecost to know assuredly that God had made Jesus both Lord and Christ, and Judas gave the soldiers a sign to take Jesus safely, without a stir. The same adverb covers certainty and caution.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Peter's assurance is the one that matters, because it rests on what God has done, not on what men can guard.
